newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Nationalist, Democratic Progressive parties agree to narrow scope of power expansion for president
Various new weapons to be displayed during Han Kuang No.13 military exercises in southern Taiwan
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to start cross-strait mobile telephone international roaming service on July 1
Nationalist, Democratic Progressive parties to hold fourth round of talks on constitutional amendment issues
LIBERTY TIMES - Garlic prices skyrocket, rising from T$3.6 per kg in November 1996 to T$50
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Leaders of five major state-funded research and technology centres found to have dual nationality; legislators demand they resign in three months
Many legislators leave for Hong Kong for survey visit; some try to build contact with Tung Chee-hwa, leader-designate of post-handover Special Administrative Region
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan investors in Chinese mainland not allowed to deduct China taxes in Taiwan even if they move company registration from Hong Kong to Singapore
Central bank studies possibility of merging discount window rates
